plugin.description: Adds two lines under the Main Scenario Guide: the step you are on, and how to get to it, with a compass and the distance beside them. The route understands teleports, building entrances and city aethernet, and says so. The words that name what to do are the control: press them to cast the teleport, open the Duty Finder, use the key item, perform the emote, or put the phrase in your chat box. Follow any accepted quest from your journal, not only the main scenario. Mouse and controller both reach everything.
